name: ai.genframe/genframe
title: genframe
description: Generate images, videos and SVG with Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream, Recraft, Seedance, Kling

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Shows the genframe account connected to this chat: credits balance, plan and how many generations can run at once. Free.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Lists the genframe models available to this account with their price in credits per option, aspect ratios, resolutions, durations and which inputs (reference pictures, first/last frame) they take. Call it before generating if you are unsure which model or option to use. Free.

kind.description: Only picture models, only video models, or all (default).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generates one to four pictures with a genframe model and charges the account's credits (price per picture is in list_models; failed pictures are refunded). Returns the picture(s) and download links. Waits up to about 50 seconds; if a picture is still in progress, the result gives its job_id for get_job. Pictures with real people are allowed only as the person's own photos; the content policy of genframe.ai applies.

prompt.description: What to draw. Any language. 3–1500 characters.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Default: a fast, cheap general model.

aspect_ratio.description: For example 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 3:2. The nearest ratio the model makes is used.

count.description: How many pictures (each is charged). Default 1.

quality.description: Quality option if the model has one (see list_models options.quality).

size.description: Size option if the model has one, e.g. 1K, 2K, 4K (see list_models options.size).

reference_image_urls.description: Optional reference pictures: public https URLs (JPG, PNG, WebP up to 8 MB) or links returned by this server. Only for models with refMax > 0.

transparent_background.description: Transparent background (only models with alpha: true).

negative_prompt.description: What must not be in the picture (only models with negative: true).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Starts a video with a genframe model and charges the account's credits (refunded if it fails). Videos take about 1–6 minutes: the result gives a job_id; call get_job with wait_seconds to get the link when it is ready. Optional first/last frame pictures as public https URLs or links from this server.

prompt.description: What happens in the video. Any language. 3–1500 characters.

model.description: Video model id from list_models. Default: an inexpensive model.

aspect_ratio.description: For example 16:9, 9:16, 1:1. With a first frame the frame's proportions win.

duration.description: Seconds, one of the model's options.duration (default 5 when offered).

resolution.description: One of the model's options.resolution, e.g. 480p, 720p, 1080p (1080p and above need the Про plan).

audio.description: Sound, for models that offer it (may change the price).

first_frame_url.description: Picture to start the video from (image-to-video).

last_frame_url.description: Picture to end on (only models whose inputs.last is true; needs first_frame_url).

tools.name: vectorize
tools.description: Turns a picture into a vector SVG with Recraft (charged in credits, see list_models tools). Give job_id of one of your genframe pictures, or image_url (public https, JPG/PNG/WebP, sides 256–4096 px).

pro.description: Recraft Pro vectorizer (more detail, more credits).

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Doubles the size of a picture with Topaz (from the Дизайн plan, charged in credits). Give job_id of one of your genframe pictures or image_url.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Removes the background of a picture (PNG with transparency; from the Дизайн plan, charged in credits). Give job_id of one of your genframe pictures or image_url.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: Lists genframe «Готовые промты» presets: turn a person's photo into a stylised avatar (e.g. crime-game poster, spy film poster). Each has several scenes (styles). Free.

tools.name: generate_preset
tools.description: Makes an avatar from the user's own photo with a genframe preset and scene (see list_presets). Charged like one picture. Use only a photo of the user themself or of someone who agreed.

style.description: Scene id from list_presets (default: the first).

photo_url.description: The person's photo: public https URL or a link from this server.

photo_job_id.description: Or one of the user's genframe pictures.

logo_url.description: Presets with needs_logo: the user's own company logo (PNG or JPG), shown on the stage screen. Public https URL or a link from this server.

caption.description: Text on the poster for scenes with a caption; empty string = no text.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status of a generation by job_id: running, done (with the picture or video link) or failed (credits refunded). wait_seconds (0–50) waits for it to finish. Free.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: The latest pictures and videos of this account (newest first) with job ids and download links. Free.
